desc: convert an Atari Degas .pi3 file into a PBM image
r: pi3topbm - convert an Atari Degas .pi3 file into a PBM image

This program is part of Netpbm(1).

pi3topbm reads an Atari Degas .pi3 file as input and produces a PBM image as output.

There are no command line options defined specifically for pi3topbm, but it recognizes the options common to all programs based on libnetpbm (See
Common Options .)
